lines.en: label futabadorm50:
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: : Whooooo is it?~
But instead, I am greeted by Nodoka- a person I’ve yet to deal with since the Yumi incident.
lines.zh: 但开门迎接我的却是 Nodoka——自从 Yumi 那件事之后，我还没跟她打过交道。

lines.en: And while I wasn’t planning on reconciling with her tonight (Nor do I know if “reconciliation” would even be applicable here in the first place), leaving now seems kind of...out of the question.
lines.zh: 虽然我今晚并不打算和她和解（我甚至都不确定“和解”这个词在这里是否适用），但现在掉头就走似乎……不太可能。

lines.en: I’ve knocked on this door enough by now that I’m sure Futaba would be able to pick mine out of {i}hundreds{/i} of other knocks.
lines.zh: 我已经敲过这扇门够多次了，我敢肯定 Futaba 能从{i}几百{/i}种敲门声里认出我的。

lines.en: And assuming Nodoka doesn’t have her tied up and nude right now, she’s probably expecting me to come inside and not just fake her out by announcing my presence and immediately running away.
lines.zh: 而且只要 Nodoka 这会儿没把她绑起来剥光，她大概就在等我进去，而不是我报个到就跑、把她耍一道。

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself as I open the door, knowing full well that the type of person I am disallows me from avoiding anyone- particularly girls I want to have sex with.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气推开门，心里很清楚，我这种人根本躲不开任何人——尤其是那些我想跟她们上床的女孩。

lines.en: And even though Nodoka’s last showing was, in no way, something I respect or would have done myself, I still do {i}like{/i} her.
lines.zh: 而且虽说 Nodoka 上次的所作所为完全不是我会欣赏、更不是我自己会做出来的事，但我依然{i}喜欢{/i}她。

lines.en: And Futaba must as well if she’s still letting her get that close.
lines.zh: 而 Futaba 一定也一样，否则不会还让她靠得那么近。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm1
I guess the chances of Futaba knowing what {i}actually{/i} happened are rather slim, though, as I doubt she’d lend her shoulder to a sexual assailant.
lines.zh: 不过我想，Futaba 知道{i}真相{/i}的可能性相当小，毕竟我不信她会把肩膀借给一个性侵者靠。

lines.en: To her, it just looked like Nodoka was attacked out of the blue.
lines.zh: 在她看来，Nodoka 只是莫名其妙地遭到了袭击。

lines.en: But the blue in this case is just so deep and dark that it’s hard to really decipher what that means. And no one has the time to go digging for something that is already peeking out of the surface.
lines.zh: 但这里的“莫名其妙”太深沉、太黑暗，很难真正解读出它意味着什么。而没有谁会去深挖一件已经浮出水面的事。

lines.en: She found her own answer. And even though it is the wrong one, who would I be to take that from her when possessing it allows her to feel as comfortable as this?
lines.zh: 她找到了属于自己的答案。即便那是错的，可拥有它就能让她如此安心，我又凭什么把它夺走？

lines.en: Because this is far more comfortable than she ever appeared under the weight of an aggressor.
lines.zh: 因为这比她在施暴者重压下那副模样，要安心得多。

lines.en: : Futaba, look. Papa is home.
lines.zh: : Futaba，你看。爸爸回来了。

lines.en: : Do you think he brought any sweets for us to share? Or do you think perhaps we {i}are{/i} the sweets...and he has come to devour us whole?
lines.zh: : 你说他有没有给我们带甜点分着吃呢？还是说……也许我们{i}才是{/i}甜点……而他是来把我们整个吞掉的？

lines.en: : I think that...the latter is probably closer to being true. I don’t know if I’d use the word “devour,” though...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……后者可能更接近事实。不过我不会用“吞掉”这个词……

lines.en: : Which one of us will you have first, Sensei? And what will become of the one who’s forced to watch?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你先享用我们中的哪一个？而被迫在旁边看着的那个，又会落得什么下场？

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you’d be here as well, Nodoka. How are you feeling?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你也在，Nodoka。你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm2
: Why, I feel closer to Heaven than I’ve ever felt before. If you’d come any earlier, you may have even seen my childhood friend here performing {i}special{/i} services both for and {i}on{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我感觉比以往任何时候都更接近天堂。你要是再来早一点，说不定还能看到我这位青梅竹马正在为我、还{i}在我身上{/i}提供{i}特殊{/i}服务呢。

lines.en: : Futaba, if you’ve been bisexual this whole time, you should have lent Rin a hand. Getting some of that pent-up energy out of her could have potentially saved her from a bad decision or two.
lines.zh: : Futaba，如果你一直都是双性恋，那你早该帮 Rin 一把了。把她那股憋着的劲儿发泄出来，说不定还能让她少做几个错误的决定。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm3
: I’m sorry to break it to you, but that’s...not what Nodoka was alluding to...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉要让你失望，但 Nodoka 指的不是那个……

lines.en: : I just gave her a little massage. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是给她做了个按摩。就这样。

lines.en: : Happy ending and all.
lines.zh: : 还带“快乐结局”的那种。

lines.en: : It was just a normal ending. Please don’t listen to her.
lines.zh: : 只是个普通的结局。别听她的。

lines.en: : Well, I guess it’s good to see you’re both okay. I was a little worried that Nodoka may have lost some of her memories and that {i}you’d{/i} still be in pieces somehow blaming yourself for what happened.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来你们俩都没事，那我就放心了。我还有点担心 Nodoka 会不会失忆了，而{i}你会{/i}因为发生的事自责得支离破碎。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm4
: I mean...it’s kind of hard {i}not{/i} to. What other common ground do Yumi and Nodoka even share? It pretty much {i}has{/i} to be something involving me, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……这有点难。Yumi 和 Nodoka 之间到底有什么共同点？{i}总归{/i}是跟我有关的事吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Do you think Yumi would really go that far just to bully someone?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Yumi 真会为了欺负别人做到那种地步吗？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm5
: Of course she would. People like that don’t need a reason for {i}anything{/i} they do. They act on impulse...{i}instinct.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她当然会。那种人做{i}什么{/i}都不需要理由。他们凭冲动行事……凭{i}本能{/i}。

lines.en: : And sometimes, those animalistic tendencies wind up showing the best of us. Wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 而有时候，那些兽性反而能显现出我们当中最好的一面。你不同意吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I follow.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定我听懂了。

lines.en: : Then perhaps a little question is in order?
lines.zh: : 那或许该问个小问题？

lines.en: : If an animal is coated in its own blood with its innards splayed out across the forest floor, is {i}it{/i} the one deserving of the blame for its fate to be devoured?
lines.zh: : 如果一只动物浑身是血，内脏摊在森林的地面上，那么它被吞噬的命运，该怪{i}它自己{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Or do we shun the ravenous horde that feasts upon the flesh, converting the weak into sustenance? The sustenance into progression.
lines.zh: : 还是说，我们该唾弃那群饕餮的野兽——它们大快朵颐，把弱者化作养料，把养料化作进步？

lines.en: : Do you really think it’s accurate to be comparing yourself to a dying animal?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得自己能和一只垂死的动物相提并论吗？

lines.en: : Silly Sensei. It appears you’ve gotten my little metaphor backwards.
lines.zh: : 傻瓜 Sensei。看来你把我的小比喻理解反了。

lines.en: : I don’t really...get any of this stuff about animals and predators, but...
lines.zh: : 这些关于动物和捕食者的东西我其实……不太懂，不过……

lines.en: : I don’t think it would be {i}impossible{/i} for Yumi to do something like that...
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Yumi 会做出那种事也并非{i}不可能{/i}……

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm6
: What do you think, Sensei? You’ve been spending more time with Yumi lately, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Sensei？你最近和 Yumi 待在一起的时间变多了吧？

lines.en: : Do you know something that may have...set her off?
lines.zh: : 你知道有什么事可能……刺激到她吗？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm7
: Yes...{i}do you{/i} know of something like that, Sensei? Because it would have to be {i}pretty bad{/i} to warrant a beating like the one I received, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……{i}你知道{/i}些什么吗，Sensei？因为能招来我挨的那顿打，那件事肯定{i}相当严重{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...I imagine it would. But I think you’d know a little better about what that could be than me, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想是的。不过那种事你应该比我更清楚吧？

lines.en: : Mmm...I don’t think so? I’m just as confused as you are.
lines.zh: : 唔……我不这么觉得？我和你一样困惑。

lines.en: : So you {i}haven’t{/i} gone out of your way to provoke her behind Futaba’s back and seek vengeance on her behalf?
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}没有{/i}特意瞒着 Futaba 去招惹她、替她报仇？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm8
: You didn’t...actually do anything like that, did you?
lines.zh: : 你……真的没做过那种事吧？

lines.en: : Not that I can recall. But, if you’d like my two cents, I don’t think there’s {i}anything{/i} I could have done to that girl that could make up for all the pain she caused you.
lines.zh: : 我记得没有。不过，要是你想听听我的意见，我觉得我对那丫头做{i}什么{/i}，都弥补不了她给你造成的那些痛苦。

lines.en: : It’s true that Yumi hurt me...a lot...and that I’ve always been really afraid of her...but I wouldn’t want {i}her{/i} to suffer as well just because of that.
lines.zh: : Yumi 确实伤了我……很深……而且我一直都很怕她……但我不会因此就希望{i}她{/i}也遭罪。

lines.en: : Yes, because you’re a genuinely good person amidst a sea of evil ones. A person who would give up her own flotation device to save the life of the man who sunk the ship.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为你是那片恶人之海中一个真正的好人。一个愿意把救生圈让给那个把船凿沉的人的人。

lines.en: : How unfortunate it is that the best among us must suffer the most while the worst are revered for their efforts in bettering themselves.
lines.zh: : 多么不幸啊，我们当中最好的人必须承受最多的苦，而最坏的人却因为“自我改善”的努力而备受尊崇。

lines.en: : What good is planting one tree in a forest you razed yourself?
lines.zh: : 在你亲手焚毁的森林里种下一棵树，又有什么用呢？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm9
: Unfortunately, Sensei and I can’t relate to that as the two of {i}us{/i} have razed our share of forests as well.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，Sensei 和我都无法对此感同身受，因为{i}我们俩{/i}也都烧过属于我们自己的那片森林。

lines.en: : I don’t...think either of you are anything like that. I can’t imagine you ever doing anything to purposely hurt someone.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你们俩都不是那种人。我无法想象你们会故意去伤害谁。

lines.en: : But if we did...if we {i}did{/i} hurt others in the same fashion Yumi hurt you...how would your thoughts of us change?
lines.zh: : 但如果我们做了呢……如果我们也像 Yumi 伤害你那样去{i}伤害{/i}别人……你对我们的看法会怎么变？

lines.en: : Would you still invite us into this room with open arms? Lend us your bosom when we long for something to cry into?
lines.zh: : 你还会张开双臂邀请我们进这间屋子吗？还会在我们想找个地方哭的时候，把胸膛借给我们吗？

lines.en: : Or would you search for someone a little “better” to hand off your flotation device to?
lines.zh: : 还是会去找个“更好”的人，把你的救生圈交给他？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm10
: All things considered, I’d like to remain floating with both of you as this shared company injects life back into this slowly rotting heart of mine.
lines.zh: : 综合考虑下来，我愿意继续和你们两个一起浮着，因为这份共处的时光正往我这颗慢慢腐烂的心里重新注入生命。

lines.en: : Don’t say things like that about yourself, Nodoka...you know I don’t like that.
lines.zh: : 别这么说自己，Nodoka……你知道我不喜欢听。

lines.en: : Apologies, bestie. The day I do something to hurt you is the day I breathe my last.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，闺蜜。我若做出什么伤害你的事，那便是我咽下最后一口气之时。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm11
: But I suppose I’ve overstayed my welcome tonight as there is a large man hovering over us who very much would like to revel in that bosom I spoke of just seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，今晚我待得够久了——毕竟有个高大的男人正俯视着我们，而且非常想享用我几秒前才提到的那片胸襟。

lines.en: : You know that...we don’t always just...{i}you know...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道的……我们也不是每次都……{i}那个{/i}……

lines.en: : Oh, I know. But the fact that it happens at all fills me with a breed of jealousy I have a hard time finding the words to describe.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。可光是它会发生这一点，就让我生出一种难以言喻的嫉妒。

lines.en: : And I also have some...{i}errands{/i} I must run.
lines.zh: : 而且我还有些……{i}事{/i}要去办。

lines.en: : How lucky you are, Sensei. Being able to {i}take{/i} whatever you want without consequence while the rest of us struggle endlessly in pursuit of that same fruit.
lines.zh: : 你多幸运啊，Sensei。可以随心所欲地{i}索取{/i}而不必承担后果，而我们其他人却要为了同一种果实无休止地挣扎。

lines.en: : You’re truly a role model, you know? And I hope with all of my rotting heart to one day drink from the same overflowing chalice that rests in your hands.
lines.zh: : 你真是个榜样，你知道吗？我怀着这颗腐烂的心，衷心希望有一天也能从你手中那只满溢的圣杯里痛饮。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm12
: Goodnight, Futaba. And goodnight, Da- heh.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Futaba。还有晚安，爸——呵。

lines.en: : Goodnight, {i}Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : 晚安，{i}Sensei{/i}。

lines.en: : Almost let my fantasies get the better of me there.
lines.zh: : 差点就让我的幻想占了上风。

lines.en: Nodoka leaves the room and I wonder to myself why I continue to let this infected wound fester beneath a layer of adhesive instead of ripping the bandage off and medicating it.
lines.zh: Nodoka 离开房间，我不禁自问，为什么我任由这处溃烂的伤口在胶布底下继续化脓，而不是干脆撕掉绷带、上药治疗。

lines.en: But as the door closes and I turn back to Futaba, I remember that part of the reason is that I’m just too interested in how the wound feels when I poke it.
lines.zh: 但当门关上、我转回身看向 Futaba 时，我想起来了：一部分原因在于，我太着迷于戳它时那伤口的触感。

lines.en: The other part is that I worry ripping the bandage off will just create a larger wound.
lines.zh: 另一部分原因在于，我担心撕掉绷带只会造就一个更大的伤口。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka knows too much.
lines.zh: Nodoka 知道得太多了。

lines.en: In fact, that’s {i}all{/i} Nodoka does when she’s not busy masterminding plans to strip the girls she dislikes down and offer them up to me like a cat dropping a dead mouse at the feet of its master.
lines.zh: 事实上，Nodoka 除了忙着策划把她讨厌的女孩扒光、像猫把死老鼠叼到主人脚边那样献给我之外，也就{i}只{/i}会干这件事了。

lines.en: I did not ask for this- but it is something I have now.
lines.zh: 我并没有要求这些——但它现在是我的一部分了。

lines.en: And until I find a way to properly dispose of it, I must continue feeding it and loving it and appreciating it.
lines.zh: 而在找到妥善处置它的办法之前，我必须继续喂养它、爱它、欣赏它。

lines.en: For despite those that suffer due to the sharp cuts of her canines, I have only felt the opposite-
lines.zh: 因为尽管有人因她犬齿的利刃而受苦，我所感受到的却恰恰相反——

lines.en: A never ending influx of new experiences, each more pleasurable yet less believable than the last and only attainable through the deepest depths of my mind.
lines.zh: 源源不断涌来的新体验，一次比一次更愉悦，也一次比一次更难以置信，而且只有在我心灵的最深处才能触及。

lines.en: How she made it there, I don’t know.
lines.zh: 她是如何走到那里的，我不知道。

lines.en: But I am far too afraid to remove her.
lines.zh: 但我实在太害怕把她移除。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm13
I take a seat on the bed and redirect my attention to Futaba, who shoots me a glance halfway between apologetic and relieved.
lines.zh: 我在床上坐下，把注意力转回 Futaba 身上，她瞥了我一眼，那眼神介于歉意和如释重负之间。

lines.en: I return it with an exasperated sigh and we both silently agree that Nodoka, even when all she’s doing is resting her head on the shoulder of her friend, is very exhausting to be around.
lines.zh: 我回以一声疲惫的叹息，我们俩在沉默中达成共识：Nodoka 就算只是把头靠在朋友的肩膀上，跟她待在一起也累得要命。

lines.en: But that’s fine...because Futaba is the complete inverse of that- and I struggle to think of a time when being around her did {i}not{/i} fill me with a sense of extreme comfort.
lines.zh: 但没关系……因为 Futaba 与她完全相反——我几乎想{i}不{/i}出有哪一次和她在一起时，不让我感到无比安心。

lines.en: But it’s that exact thought that makes me question just how she found herself letting a virus like Nodoka in.
lines.zh: 但正是这个念头让我困惑：她怎么会允许 Nodoka 这样的病毒进来。

lines.en: And I wonder if it is just one more example of her helping someone who should probably just sink stay afloat instead.
lines.zh: 而我不禁怀疑，这是否又是一个例子——她去帮一个本该沉下去的人继续浮着。

lines.en: : Do you really trust her, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你真的信任她吗，Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm14
: Nodoka? Why wouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？为什么不呢？

lines.en: : I don’t know. She doesn’t seem like she’s always...scheming to you?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。她在你看来，就不像是总在……算计着什么吗？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm15
: Ah...that. Yeah, it does feel like she’s always up to something, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 啊……那个。是啊，感觉她总是在琢磨些什么，对吧？

lines.en: : Nodoka is...well, as I’m sure you’ve realized, a pretty big personality. But I don’t really think that it’s big in the wrong ways.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 嘛……嗯，你肯定也注意到了，她的个性相当强烈。但我不觉得那种强烈是错的方向。

lines.en: : There are other big personalities like...like Yumi for example. People who take over conversations and situations just by actively participating in them.
lines.zh: : 还有别的个性强烈的人，比如……比如 Yumi。那种只要一参与进来，就能主导整段对话和整个局面的人。

lines.en: : And while Nodoka does make a lot of people uncomfortable...like, {i}very{/i} uncomfortable, I’ve never really seen her make someone feel {i}bad{/i} before.
lines.zh: : 虽然 Nodoka 确实让很多人不舒服……{i}非常{/i}不舒服，但我从没见过她让谁真正{i}难过{/i}过。

lines.en: : She’s...umm...
scene futabanodokadorm16
: She’s...{i}protective.{/i} I think that’s the best word for it.
lines.zh: : 她……很{i}护短{/i}。我觉得这个词最贴切。

lines.en: : She doesn’t connect with very many people, so when she actually {i}does{/i}, she’ll do everything she can think of to keep cultivating that relationship. That’s probably where the...scheming thing comes from.
lines.zh: : 她很少能和别人建立联系，所以一旦{i}真的{/i}建立了，她就会想尽一切办法去维系那段关系。那份……算计大概就是这么来的。

lines.en: : But...take me, for example. When she stood up for me in class and...when she became Yumi’s {i}new{/i} target...that wasn’t the first time she’s ever done something like that for me.
lines.zh: : 不过……就拿我来说吧。她在课堂上替我出头，还有……当她变成 Yumi 的{i}新{/i}目标的时候……那并不是她第一次为我做那样的事。

lines.en: : She’s been sticking up for me for as long as I can remember...and I have nothing but good things to say about her.
lines.zh: : 从我记事起，她就一直在护着我……关于她，我说不出半句不好听的话。

lines.en: : But I guess I can understand if she’s a little too much for some people.
lines.zh: : 不过我也能理解，对有些人来说她确实有点过火。

lines.en: : Then, to ask the same question she tried asking before...what if you found out she wasn’t actually like that?
lines.zh: : 那么，就问她之前想问的那个问题吧……如果你发现她其实不是那样的人呢？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm17
: You mean...if she actually {i}did{/i} try to get revenge for me behind my back?
lines.zh: : 你是说……如果她{i}真的{/i}背着我替我报仇了？

lines.en: : Yeah...How would you feel about her then?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你会怎么看待她？

lines.en: : I’d feel...disappointed. Because she knows better than anyone that’s the exact opposite of what I’d want.
lines.zh: : 我会……失望。因为她比谁都清楚，那恰恰是我不想要的。

lines.en: : But it would have to be something really bad to seriously impact my relationship with her because, even if it’s something I {i}didn’t{/i} want her to do, she did it because she cares about me.
lines.zh: : 但那必须是非常严重的事，才会真正影响我和她的关系，因为即便那是我不{i}希望{/i}她做的，她做也是因为在乎我。

lines.en: : Are you sure that-
lines.zh: : 你确定——

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm18
: Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 当然确定。

lines.en: : I’ve never been more sure of anything.
lines.zh: : 我从没有对什么事这么确定过。

lines.en: : Could personal interest be a factor as well? Of course. This is Nodoka we’re talking about. She’s even more of a narcissist than you are.
lines.zh: : 会不会也有个人利害在里面？当然可能。我们说的可是 Nodoka。她比你还要自恋。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm17
: But she’s also extremely kind...
lines.zh: : 但她也极其善良……

lines.en: : She just doesn’t like when people know that.
lines.zh: : 她只是不喜欢别人知道这一点。

lines.en: : I’ll...believe that when I see it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……我大概要亲眼见到才会相信。

lines.en: : That’s the thing, though, Sensei. She probably won’t ever {i}let{/i} you see it.
lines.zh: : 可问题就在这儿，Sensei。她大概永远不会{i}让{/i}你看到。

lines.en: : Those “errands” she mentioned before leaving...what do you think they are?
lines.zh: : 她走之前说的那些“事”……你觉得是什么？

lines.en: : What do you think she’s doing right now?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她现在在做什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Probably something involving porn.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概和色情片有关吧。

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm18
: She’s taking care of her mom.
lines.zh: : 她在照顾她妈妈。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Nodoka is constantly moving back and forth between the dorms and her home because her mom isn’t...
lines.zh: : Nodoka 总是在宿舍和自己家之间来回跑，因为她妈妈没办法……

lines.en: : Well, she isn’t really able to function on her own. But that’s really all I feel comfortable telling you...
lines.zh: : 嗯，她真的没办法独自生活。不过我也只能告诉你这么多了……

lines.en: : What happened to her?
lines.zh: : 她妈妈怎么了？

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm19
: I literally just told you that was all I feel comfortable telling you...
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才说过，我只能告诉你这么多了……

lines.en: : Sure. But I’ve made you feel uncomfortable plenty of times in the past and it’s never really backfired before. Also, I doubt Nodoka will tell me anything about this if I ask.
lines.zh: : 是吗。不过我以前也让你不舒服过好多次，从来没出过什么岔子。而且我敢说，我要是去问，Nodoka 是绝对不会告诉我这些的。

lines.en: : Please don’t ask. I don’t really want her knowing that I told you.
lines.zh: : 求你别去问。我真的不想让她知道是我告诉你的。

lines.en: : I just didn’t want you thinking she was some kind of evil genius when she’s more of an...extremely eccentric, socially awkward genius who has trouble empathizing and...a dysfunctional moral compass.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你把她当成什么邪恶天才，她更像是一个……极其古怪、社交笨拙的天才，缺乏共情能力，还有……一副失灵的道德罗盘。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene futabanodokadorm18
: Does knowing {i}that{/i} change your opinion of her?
lines.zh: : 知道{i}这些{/i}，会改变你对她的看法吗？

lines.en: : I...have to think about it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我……大概得想想。

lines.en: : That’s so strange, though. I really thought you liked Nodoka. At the very least, she seems to like you a lot.
lines.zh: : 这可真奇怪。我还以为你挺喜欢 Nodoka 的。至少，她看起来很喜欢你。

lines.en: : I do like Nodoka. I just have a harder time understanding her than...all of the non-Yasu girls, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我确实喜欢 Nodoka。我只是觉得她比……所有不像 Yasu 那样的女孩都更难懂。

lines.en: Plus, I watched her singlehandedly dismantle both the life and reputation of a girl I worked genuinely hard for and that...does not sit well with me.
lines.zh: 而且我亲眼看着她凭一己之力摧毁了一个我真心努力过的女孩的生活和名声，这件事……让我如鲠在喉。

lines.en: Hearing that she’s an actual human being instead of a vengeance-robot does help a little in reshaping her inside of my mind, but...I don’t think she’ll be returning to her original form in there any time soon.
lines.zh: 听说她其实是个有血有肉的人，而不是一台复仇机器，确实多少帮我重塑了对她的印象，但是……我觉得她在我心里短期内是回不到原来的样子了。

lines.en: : I get what you’re saying. Sometimes, I think I’m the only person who {i}does{/i} understand Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我明白你的意思。有时候，我觉得自己是唯一一个{i}理解{/i} Nodoka 的人。

lines.en: : I had pretty much this same exact talk with Rin shortly after Nodoka moved into the dorms and I’m sure I’ll have it again with someone else too. I’m used to it.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 搬进宿舍后不久，我和 Rin 就谈过几乎一模一样的话，我敢肯定以后还会跟别人再谈一次。我已经习惯了。

lines.en: : To be frank, there’s a ton of stuff about her I’m sure I’ll never understand. But I don’t think you need to understand everything about someone to figure out if they’re important to you or not.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，她身上有很多东西我大概永远都不会懂。但我觉得，要判断一个人对你重不重要，并不必把他的一切都弄明白。

lines.en: : After all, there’s even more I don’t understand about {i}you{/i} and I lo-
lines.zh: : 毕竟，关于{i}你{/i}我不懂的东西还要更多，而我喜——

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm20
: LIKE YOU.
lines.zh: : 欢你。

lines.en: : You-
: NOPE.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Futaba-
lines.zh: : Futaba——

lines.en: : NOPE!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : Were you-
lines.zh: : 你刚才是——

lines.en: scene futabanodokadorm21
: STOP! IT WAS AN ACCIDENT! I WASN’T GOING TO SAY IT!
lines.zh: : 别说了！那是口误！我不是要说那个的！

lines.en: : Wow. It’s been a while since you’ve yelled at me like this.
lines.zh: : 哇。你好久没这么冲我喊了。

lines.en: : I’M NOT YELLING! I’M JUST...INFORMING YOU OF A MISTAKE I MADE!
lines.zh: : 我才没有在喊！我只是……在通知你我犯了个错误！

lines.en: : THINGS LIKE THIS HAPPEN!
lines.zh: : 这种事是会发生的！

lines.en: : But what if I was going to say it back?
lines.zh: : 可万一我也想说回去呢？

lines.en: : YOU-
scene futabanodokadorm22
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Did you just-
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是——

lines.en: scene black
: Anyway, that’s all the time I have tonight. But it was nice hanging out with you, Futaba. I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 总之，今晚我只能待到这儿了。不过和你待在一起很开心，Futaba。我们很快再见。

lines.en: : Oh come on! You can’t just leave after saying that!
lines.zh: : 别这样啊！你说了那种话怎么能就这么走！

lines.en: : I just don’t feel comfortable with you yelling at me like this. But we can hang out again soon.
lines.zh: : 我只是受不了你这么冲我喊。不过我们可以很快再聚。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come back!
lines.zh: : Sensei！回来！

lines.en: I open the door and exit Futaba’s room.
lines.zh: 我打开门，走出了 Futaba 的房间。

lines.en: I wasn’t going to say it back.
lines.zh: 我本来也不打算说回去。
